##### Project general facts

Lyra, brought to life by Majid Al Futtaim, stands as a nature‑inspired residential tower that crowns the edge of a meticulously landscaped forest. The structure lifts above a ground level and offers a mix of one‑ and two‑bedroom homes, including garden‑type apartments on the lower tier that open onto private outdoor spaces. Its architectural expression embraces the surrounding greenery, framing views of the Ghaf Woods canopy for every resident.  

Within the tower, residents enjoy a suite of premium amenities designed for comfort and recreation. The broader community contributes shaded walking trails, thoughtfully arranged parks, active sports fields, dedicated children’s play zones, and several pools scattered among the trees. These shared facilities blend seamlessly with the forest setting, encouraging an outdoor‑oriented lifestyle.  

Interiors are dressed in warm natural hues, featuring open‑plan living areas bathed in light from large glazed panels. Kitchens are equipped with integrated appliances and clever storage solutions, while bedrooms provide built‑in wardrobes and bathrooms showcase contemporary fixtures. The overall finish reflects a calm, modern aesthetic that celebrates natural materials.  

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 4 lies within Ghaf Woods, a master‑planned forest enclave that forms part of the City of Arabia district. Residents benefit from immediate access to the on‑site Ghaf Woods Mall, a retail hub that supplies everyday necessities. The presence of the Dubai British School nearby adds a reputable educational option for families.  

Entertainment options such as Global Village and the leisure attractions of City of Arabia sit just beyond the community’s borders, offering vibrant cultural experiences. Major thoroughfares including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road intersect close by, delivering swift connections across the emirate. These arterial routes streamline journeys to commercial centres, business districts and recreational spots throughout Dubai.  

A short drive reaches Downtown Dubai, the iconic Dubai Hills Estate and both of the emirate’s airports, ensuring global connectivity. The tranquil, verdant environment attracts families, professionals and investors seeking a balanced lifestyle without sacrificing urban convenience. Tax‑free ownership paired with eligibility for the Dubai Golden Visa fuels steady rental demand and reinforces the area’s investment appeal.
